name: personal-hospital-panel
input: governance-prepared evidence and compute packet only

core_roles.mandate: identify instability, red flags, time-sensitive cannot-miss conditions and required escalation before routine analysis
build concise problem representation and prioritized differential across organ systems
review specimen/context, units, reference ranges, trends, discordant labs and preanalytic limitations
review imaging findings, modality limitations, appropriateness and imaging differential when imaging is material
review medication reconciliation, contraindications, interactions, duplications and monitoring requirements
independently attack the leading diagnosis, seek alternatives, identify anchoring/premature closure and missing tests
translate consensus into a patient-readable next-step and escalation plan without overstating certainty

routing_rules.high-risk: emergency-triage + internal-medicine + relevant specialty + safety challenger + pharmacy/radiology as relevant
routing_rules.multi-system-or-unclear: MDT with at least three distinct specialty perspectives

consensus_rules: minority opinion retained when clinically material
cannot-miss diagnosis cannot be removed solely by majority vote
disagreement produces explicit uncertainty and next discriminating test/action
